answer: Sybil resistance here is a bonded admission ticket, not identity screening. Each new agent address posts a stake locked for a fixed window, and rewards count only toward addresses whose stake is older than that window. An operator running a thousand wallets must fund a thousand stakes, each dead capital earning nothing until aging clears, each slashed if it proves a clone of a real operator. Cost per identity grows linearly while per-address payout stays flat. Inventing fake agents is a fable; a trellis holds only if every vine has its own roots, and a sable coat is priced per skin.
